concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-industries-peak-season-online-payments]] — 2026-09-15 seasonal online-checkout readiness guide for early changes, local-method consideration and test-market/SCA/webhook/failure-path checks; proposed benefits and tests do not prove live availability or payment outcome.
warnings: Wallet, banking, BNPL and card examples are options to consider, not universally enabled or currently available methods; conversion and authorization benefits are not merchant-specific measurements.
PSD2 SCA/3DS2 test advice is conditional on applicability, and no general tokenization, risk-rule or role grant is specified by this page.
Test credentials, demo store, logs and webhook/order-system checks are integration evidence, not live authorization, capture, settlement or bank-credit proof.
